title: Siman 380
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: לְנַקּוֹת הַגּוּף מִתַּאֲווֹת כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּעַבְּדִין הָעוֹר וּמְהַפְּכִין אוֹתוֹ. כָּךְ צָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הַגּוּף נָקִי וּמְעֻבָּד
segments.en: (42.) He said that in his Aleph-Beis book, under the letter reish for refu'ah [healing], all the cures were written there — and there was no illness in the world whose cure was not written there. But he did not want to copy it out, and he burned it.
